title: build(deps): bump axios from 1.21.0 to 1.21.1 in /packages/client
intent: Dependabot currency with a transitive security fix. axios 1.21.1 raises its follow-redirects floor to ^1.16.2, and the lockfile resolves follow-redirects 1.16.3, which strips sensitive headers on cross-host redirects even when headers are passed as a flat array and escapes every regex syntax character in the host match. Production dependency, patch version inside the existing ^1 range. Manifest authored by hand: Dependabot cannot author one and CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 makes a borrowed one invalid.
behavior_change: None in the shipped client. vite build on the same tree with axios 1.21.0 + follow-redirects 1.16.0 and with axios 1.21.1 + follow-redirects 1.16.3 produced 199 files each, byte-identical (diff -rq empty); dist contains no axios version string, XSRF-TOKEN or follow-redirects. Axios ships zero bytes (see AXIOS_1_21_0_BUMP and CLIENT-AXIOS-REACHABILITY-020), and follow-redirects is reached only through axios's Node http adapter, which a browser build never includes. Effect is limited to Node-side tooling (vitest).

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json declares axios ^1.21.1 (was ^1.21.0). package-lock.json = origin/main's lockfile + the root axios range + two package entries: node_modules/axios 1.21.0 -> 1.21.1 (its follow-redirects range ^1.16.0 -> ^1.16.2) and node_modules/follow-redirects 1.16.0 -> 1.16.3. Two CI tests that pin the live declaration now expect ^1.21.1: test_client_axios_reachability.py (two assertions) and test_client_rosette_compare_lineage.py (one).
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot PR #490 failed API Tests, Core CI Summary and both CBSP21 gates: the pinned assertions expected ^1.21.0 and there was no manifest. The CI job stopped at the reachability step, so the lineage test's identical pin had not surfaced yet.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No source file, no build/lint/test configuration, no other dependency. Lockfile peer flags stay as on main: Dependabot's regeneration flipped `peer` on 16 unchanged-version entries (npm-version churn), reverted per main's convention. The preservation archive's historical axios_declared ^1.21.0 is unchanged. The preservation tool's own live gate is NOT edited here: it is preservation-owned, and the boundary test forbids editing it together with package.json, so its fix (accept any ^1.x.y) went in separately as PR #495, merged as 324ccf7b before this PR's final merge of main.

commands_run: git merge origin/main 3291df78 into the Dependabot head 0ae998ec (no force-push)

lockfile JSON enumeration origin/main vs 0ae998ec -> 405 -> 405 entries, 0 added, 0 removed; version moves exactly axios 1.21.0->1.21.1 and follow-redirects 1.16.0->1.16.3; 16 entries differ only in the `peer` flag
lockfile rebuilt = origin/main lockfile + axios root range + the two package entries; serializer round-trips main byte-for-byte; git diff origin/main -- packages/client shows only those changes

npm view: axios@1.21.1 and follow-redirects@1.16.3 dist.integrity == lockfile; axios published by GitHub Actions trusted publisher (OIDC), approver jasonsaayman, SLSA provenance v1, same path as 1.21.0; follow-redirects by the same maintainer as 1.16.0; no preinstall/install/postinstall in either

npm pack + diff: axios lib/ changes only dispatchRequest.js (response.duration timed with performance.now() when available, rounded) and env/data.js (VERSION); index.d.ts adds an optional config param to getAdapter. follow-redirects index.js: array-form headers normalized to an object before sensitive-header handling; escapeRegex escapes ^ [ ] { } |; README adds a maintenance-paused / funding notice
vite build A/B (1.21.1+1.16.3 vs npm i --no-save axios@1.21.0 follow-redirects@1.16.0) -> 199 files each, diff -rq empty
git merge origin/main 324ccf7b (after #495); git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD touches no OWNED_PREFIXES path, so the preservation boundary test is out of scope
manual_verifications: Lockfile enumerated by parsing both JSON trees, not by reading the diff view (PR #296 precedent).

The reported failure named two assertions; grep for ^1.21.0 found five more. Three are historical records of the preserved SOURCE_COMMIT (tool lines emitting axios_declared and the capability index; preservation test line 116) and must stay. Two read the live package.json: the lineage test (updated here) and the preservation tool's gate (separate PR, see what_did_not_change).

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Dependency bump; no architectural surface. Recorded, not acted on: follow-redirects' README now says maintenance is paused for lack of funding and security reports are best-effort; it reaches this repo only through axios's Node adapter, which the browser bundle excludes.
